description: Draw on the player's screen only, for a while: a build preview, or highlights through walls. Nothing in the world changes.
help: Draw on the player's screen only, for a while: a build preview, or highlights through walls. Nothing in the world changes.
- preview: wire boxes of a planned structure layout (build structure's dry run), plus cells and boxes
- highlight: show the player where things, a network or far points are, tinted and labelled
Every what here takes: clear, keep, seconds.
Shaping on every call: fields, omit, list_limits, output_file, whole, repeat (help {topic: "shaping"}).
help {verb: "show", what} gives a what's options, reply keys and an example.

tool.what: preview: wire boxes of a planned structure layout (build structure's dry run), plus cells and boxes; highlight: show the player where things, a network or far points are, tinted and labelled

options.prefab: Prefab: a whole name, a hash, or parts with * ('*Battery*', '*Tank*Insulated*': each part, any order); or a list of them.
options.targets: Up to 64, each one of {id (one or a list), network, at} with color, label, pulse.
